headline: Small SE swell on a prime angle but cross-on all day — dawn log session at best.
today: There's a prime SE angle in the water with a hint of longer period, but it's only knee-to-thigh and the wind never gets better than a 7mph ESE cross-on in the morning. Best you'll do is a glassy-ish dawn or the mid-morning window around the 10:34 low before the SW cross-on fills in. Grab the log, keep expectations low, and don't rush out of bed.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE swell up to 2.8ft with a 7mph cross-on dawn — surf early, because the wind cranks to 17mph onshore by afternoon and trashes it.
Small at 1-1.4ft but clean NNW offshore all morning — worth a dawn check on the log if you want a mellow glassy one.
